name: QDento
what_it_is: A free cross-platform dental practice management desktop application built with Qt6/C++. International fork of DinoDent, stripped of Bulgaria-specific integrations, intended as a clean baseline for country-specific customisation.
configuration: Qt Creator or Visual Studio build
SQLite3 and JsonCpp sources extracted before build
constraints: No cloud sync or remote database; local SQLite only
No country-specific billing or insurance integrations
